selection_reason: Existing shared evaluated WGS regression chromosomes with VarDepth, GATK and DeepVariant; applied identically to every assay. Availability-constrained, not random or prospectively unseen.
uncertainty_limitation: Two whole-chromosome summaries do not support reliable regional or across-person bootstrap. Do not treat individual variants as independent Bernoulli trials.
missing_comparisons: QUILT2 indels unsupported in existing protocol
